releases.body: The usage card is now a single total balance in the currency's own glyph (¥185.93) — no composition rows, no meters. As a pure balance card, magpie keeps a money history: the trend line is the amount over time with a run-out estimate.
Recharge now reads as Paid / 付费 — the amount the user actually paid in.

Usage card is now one balance with its composition written inside it: the total leads, nonzero parts (recharge, gift credit, debt, frozen) follow. This makes magpie keep an amount history, so the trend line is money over time instead of a flat 100% percent line. Zero parts are hidden; bonus renamed to 赠金.

releases.name: v0.1.0 — TokenRhythm (OpenSquilla)
releases.body:
First release of the TokenRhythm (OpenSquilla) provider plugin for Magpie / OpenCode.

- Browser sign-in (OAuth2 + PKCE loopback) with managed model key and live wallet balance card
- BYOK API key sign-in
- 30-model live catalog incl. NeoHorse-Jev-4B (System One decision model for magpie routing groups)
- Full key surface: OpenAI chat / Anthropic messages / embeddings / Wan 3.0 videos / JEV decision
- Session keep-alive with managed-key rotation
